reason: Checked at 17:29Z. The finding holds, but the proposed fix contradicts itself. (1) Timer.sh PID 30820 is alive with the args '2026-09-29T18:13:00Z HOURLY RESEARCH ROUND 45 (21:13 MSK): READS-vs-CARD ...'. The 18:37Z (29184), 19:43Z, 21:05Z and 00:07Z timers, t7_trigger 16748 and waiter 29828 are alive as well. (2) Clean poll.log headers come every 10:02-10:03 (17:15:03Z, then 17:25:06Z). The projected headers are 18:15:2x, 18:25:2x and 18:35:2x. exp89t 56669888 was still PENDING at 17:25:06Z, so its read will most likely land at one of these three headers, 2-22 min after the 18:13Z timer. (3) A round takes ~30 min in the main session: round 43 ran 16:13 to 16:43Z, and round 44 launched at 17:13Z was still running at 17:28Z. (4) Round 45's lens is READS-vs-CARD, and at 18:13Z it has no read to work on. The round43 plan scheduled it before its own input exists. scan_hyp_ops44's readtime.sh already builds the read code, the R39-A4 comparator and the card in one call, so round 45 adds nothing before the card. (5) Deferring an ops round touches none of R1-R10, the finals rule or decision B, and needs 0 Kaggle calls. Value: it protects the only output that matters tonight, the read push plus the 18:37Z card the user needs before the 23:00 MSK tick. DEFECT in the action: 'launch round 45 around 18:40-18:45Z' plus ~30 min ends at ~19:10-19:15Z. That breaks the finding's own 19:05-19:50Z no-round window and collides with T7, which fires at the first header >= 19:12:17Z, i.e. ~19:15:3xZ. So the fallback must be to skip, or to cap the round hard.
fix: Adopt with this amendment. (a) Now: log one CONTEXT line: '18:13Z timer (timer.sh 30820) = NO-OP; round 45 is not launched at 18:13Z'. A resumed or restarted session must not act on the timer text. Optionally TaskStop that task. If you do, confirm by exact PID with Get-CimInstance Win32_Process (ProcessId -eq 30820, plus wrappers 18108/28716) that it is gone, and do not use a -match filter that would hit the other timer.sh processes (29184, 20960, 24260, 21232 must stay alive). (b) 18:15-18:37Z: handle the exp89t read as one call (awk first terminal header for --hdr, then readtime.sh), push the R40-A4/R41-A2 text, then build and send the 18:37Z card with mk_card_1837.py (a19e1bd6). (c) Round 45: SKIP by default. The card step already covers READS-vs-CARD, because readtime.sh applies the R39-A4 comparator. Run it only if the card was sent by 18:40Z, the read was T1/T2/T6/T8 (not T3KEEP/T5), and it runs as a minimal local-files lens with a hard stop at 19:00Z. Otherwise do not start it, because 19:05-19:50Z (T7 ~19:15:3xZ, manual-admit 19:44:45Z, reader 19:47Z) must stay free.
realistic_gain: No score change. It removes a ~30-min main-session block that could delay the exp89t read push and the 18:37Z card past ~18:45Z, and push a late round into T7 (~19:15Z). This protects the user's informed tick before 23:00 MSK (20:00Z). Cost: 0 Kaggle calls and one CONTEXT line.
